sources: Clannibal (batch 4, written with Tangtang's kit: docs/kit-batches/batch-4/chr_0027_tangtang.md). rmxlinux Json/SkillData/sk_wpn_pistol_0009 (weapon skill 3, SkillPatchTable L1–L9: spell_dmg_up 0.12–0.336, dmg_taken_up 0.10–0.28, duration 15, cd 25): cardAttributeModifier attributes 51–54 formulaItem 5 +spell_dmg_up (Arts DMG, stat panel). passiveEventActions: four abilityEvent 208 listeners (the wielder consumes a buff), each CheckBuffIdInContext on one reaction tag (−1110095722 Combustion, 1466867135 Electrification, 1535684437 Solidification, −421286163 Corrosion) and CheckGlobalCDTimerAction on buff_wpn_pistol_0009_cd (one 25 s cooldown for all four) → buff_wpn_pistol_0009_dmg_taken_up_{f,p,c,n} on the target: DamageScaleProcessor side 1 NormalCalcZone +dmg_taken_up for damageType 2 / 3 / 4 / 6 (Heat, Electric, Cryo, Nature), `duration`; stackingType 1 priority lv.

"After the wielder consumes an Arts Reaction, target enemy suffers Arts DMG Taken +{dmg_taken_up} (for the specified element) for {duration}s. Each effect applies separately and does not stack with itself. Effect only triggers once every {cd}s."

buffs.label: Vicious Purge: cooldown
buffs.note: The shared 25 s cooldown (AddGlobalCDTimer) as a state: each trigger checks it at the event, so one cooldown covers the four reactions.

triggers.note: abilityEvent 208 (the wielder consumes a buff) + CheckBuffIdInContext checkType 1 on the combustion tag. One shared cooldown: CheckGlobalCDTimerAction / AddGlobalCDTimer buff_wpn_pistol_0009_cd (cd 25 s) in all four listeners.
